newsitem.title: USA: CBOT old crop soybeans turn firm late.
newsitem.headline: CBOT old crop soybeans turn firm late.

text.p: CBOT old crop soybean futures turned firm in late trading amid thin dealings with small-lot fund buying boosting prices, traders said.
"It's very thin, just a group of them bought a small amount," a trader said.
Griffin Trading and Prudential Securities bought one half million bushels of January, Refco Inc bought one million May and Tenco Inc bought one half million bushels of September, traders said.
At 1257 CDT, soybeans were three cents up to 10-1/2 cents lower, with July up 1/2 at $8.64-1/2.
